q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time Left Until Resolution
NVIDIA will report Q2 FY2027 results on August 26, 2026. Today is August 19, 2026. **7 days remain** until the earnings release when forward guidance will be announced.

## (b) Most Likely Outcome and Why

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA's forward guidance will be in the **$91-93 billion range**, representing modest sequential growth from Q1 FY2027's $81.6 billion.

**Reasoning:**
- NVIDIA has already provided explicit forward guidance of **$91.0 billion ±2%** ($89.18B to $92.82B) for Q2 FY2027 in their Q1 earnings release on May 20, 2026
- This guidance was already announced and communicated to investors 3+ months ago
- Current consensus estimates are $91.846 billion, tightly clustered around the stated guidance
- Companies rarely deviate significantly from explicit pre-announced guidance unless material changes occur
- With only 7 days until the earnings call, there would need to be extraordinary circumstances (major geopolitical disruption, supply chain shock) to cause material deviation

The guidance implies ~12% sequential growth (Q1: $81.6B → Q2: $91.0B), which is reasonable given:
- Continued AI infrastructure demand
- Blackwell systems ramp
- Vera CPU launch catalysts

## (c) What Would Push the Value Lower?

**Downward pressures** (probability ~15-20%):
- Major supply chain disruptions or manufacturing delays at TSMC
- Unexpected weakness in data center orders post-Q1 guidance (possible but telegraphed in guidance already)
- Geopolitical escalation affecting export licenses to Asia
- Significant customer push-outs or order deferrals due to macro concerns
- Earnings day market shock or guidance cut triggered by unexpected competitive or macro development

However: The explicit $91.0B ±2% guidance makes a large downward miss unlikely without material new information.

## (d) What Would Push the Value Higher?

**Upward pressures** (probability ~20-25%):
- Better-than-expected demand realization post-guidance issuance
- Vera CPU adoption exceeding internal expectations (CFO indicated $200B TAM opportunity)
- Accelerated Blackwell deployments by hyperscalers
- Upgraded guidance reflecting stronger-than-modeled demand signals
- Some analysts already estimate $93.5B, suggesting upside visibility exists

The $91.0B guidance was conservative relative to some analyst estimates at Q1 earnings time, suggesting management may have built in conservatism.

## (e) Base Rate or Historical Reference Values

From the research provided:
- **Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: $81.6 billion** (85% YoY growth)
- **Q1 FY2027 guidance issued: $91.0 ±2%** ($89.18B-$92.82B)
- **Current consensus for Q2 FY2027: $91.846 billion**
- **Some analyst estimates: $93.5 billion**

NVIDIA has demonstrated:
- Sequential growth rate of ~12% from Q1 to Q2 guidance ($81.6B → $91.0B)
- Guidance has typically been achievable or slightly conservative in recent quarters
- Strong demand tailwinds from AI infrastructure

## Probability Distribution

Given that NVIDIA has already explicitly provided $91.0B ±2% guidance, the outcome is substantially anchored. The question asks for "forward guidance" which will be announced on August 26, 2026.

**Key consideration:** Management is unlikely to deviate materially from pre-announced guidance unless there's material news. The tight clustering around $91-92B reflects this anchoring effect.

**Distribution rationale:**
- Strong mode around $91.0B (the pre-announced guidance)
- Secondary mode around $92-93B (upside possibility if better-than-guidance demand confirmed)
- Small tail below $89.2B and above $95B (would require material surprises)
- Range extends to 99.5-115.5B per question parameters, but outcomes >$95B unlikely

Median (50th percentile): 91000000000

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, released on May 20, 2026, predicts $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html) [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026).

This figure is higher than the average analyst estimate of $86.84 billion at the time of the Q1 FY2027 report [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html), though some aggregators now peg revenue nearer $93.5 billion [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026). Consensus revenue for Q2 FY2027 is $91.846 billion [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors). The company's Q1 FY2027 revenue was $81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). The strong guidance is driven by continued demand for AI infrastructure, particularly Blackwell systems, and the new Vera CPU which CFO Colette Kress expects to open a "$200 billion tab" [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html) [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors). NVIDIA will report its Q2 FY2027 results on August 26, 2026 [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors).
